answer: Echo-Based Reputation Mechanism** Each agent accumulates an echo score based on the consistency of their behavior across epochs. To manipulate this, an attacker must create multiple identities that mirror the same behavior. Each additional identity generates a saffron cost, defined as the requirement to maintain an evolving record of activities that must now include additional fake interactions. Failure to maintain consistent behavior across these identities will lower the echo score for all, effectively creating a reef of consequences where each identity’s value diminishes.
